teams.heading: Stuart Barnes slams RFU ‘ostrich policy’ after Steve Borthwick receives contract extension
teams.body: Former England fly-half Stuart Barnes has criticised the RFU’s 'ostrich policy' after the governing body extended Steve Borthwick’s contract until 2028. Writing for The Times, Barnes described the head coach’s tenure as a 'failure' following a Six Nations campaign that featured a historic loss to Italy. While England recently concluded their summer schedule with a 31-24 victory over Argentina, Barnes insists the side has slipped to 'second-tier' status. The RFU maintains the extension provides vital continuity as preparations for the 2027 World Cup in Australia intensify.

teams.heading: IRFU rejects Alan Gilpin proposal to move Six Nations matches to USA

The union emphasised that home matches remain a central part of the competition's appeal for fans in Ireland and Italy.

Damian de Allende crossed twice while Morne van den Berg, Pieter-Steph du Toit, Kurt-Lee Arendse, and Cameron Hanekom also scored in front of 68,173 fans. Siya Kolisi praised Rassie Erasmus’ influence, noting, “He knows how to get us up, and when he speaks to us he reminds us where we come from.” The result cements South Africa's status as the team to beat.
